sample_selection: First 50 test questions; includes previously used first-five development examples

summary.timing_definition: Per-question agent loop on GPU, including generation and tool waits; excludes image build, model download/load and readiness warmup

signed_same_scale_diagnostic.definition: abs(pred-gold) <= max(1e-6, abs(gold)*0.01); custom diagnostic, not paper NM

first_search_retrieval.definition: First API call only; a resolution error counts as no retrieved context. Not paper R@3 or multi-turn ever-hit.

audit_limitations: Marker/source-field checks do not prove absence of foundation-model training contamination or question-inherent answer clues.
Paper evaluation population and retrieval budget differ; pilot NM is not a replication or a superiority claim.
